app.title: Qfza
app.pageTitle: Qfza — Search Inside Videos & Jump to the Moment
app.metaDescription: Qfza lets you search inside videos and their transcripts for any word or phrase, then jump straight to the exact timestamp where it appears.
app.ogDescription: Search inside videos and their transcripts for any word or phrase, then jump directly to the exact timestamp it appears.

hero.title: Search Inside Videos
hero.subtitle: Paste a video URL and search for any word or phrase. Qfza finds where it appears and lets you jump directly to that moment.

features.title: Why Qfza
features.exactDesc: We search the full transcript word by word, so you only get timestamps where the exact phrase appears — no fuzzy matches.
features.fastDesc: A new video may take a few minutes to process. Repeat searches can reuse a cached transcript instead of starting over.
features.jumpDesc: Every result links straight to the exact moment, so you watch the scene instead of scrubbing.
features.downloadDesc: Save the full transcript as a PDF, or the video as an MP4 — whole, or from any moment to the end.

steps.title: How it works
steps.step1Desc: A public video, not a channel or playlist.
steps.step2Desc: A single word or a full sentence.
steps.step3Desc: Open an exact timestamp once your search is ready.
